name: Named memo-book planform to two loose station datums

coordinate_frame.origin: intersection of the two planned loose datum contact lines on the station base
coordinate_frame.x_positive: across the closed book's published 89 mm planform dimension
coordinate_frame.y_positive: along the closed book's published 140 mm planform dimension
coordinate_frame.z_positive: up from the station's planned desk-support plane

datums.description: planned loose side datum; left/right spine orientation remains a requirements parameter

allowed: clearance motion away from both loose datums
constrained: negative-x translation at datum A during use
negative-y translation at datum B during use

assembly.direction: from above without flexing or clamping the book
assembly.sequence_notes: Keep the top and spine side open; do not use thickness as a fit interface.

keepouts_and_access: Do not clamp or load the stapled spine.
Keep the top and removal path open.
Provide finger access without relying on an unverified book thickness.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The named variant and published planform are identified, but no independent measurement or physical fit exists; cover bow, wear and edition changes remain test variables.

failure_modes.mode: The physical book binds, rocks, or is marked at a datum.
failure_modes.effect: The station fails its placement function or cosmetically marks a low-value host item.
failure_modes.mitigation: Derive clearance only after a two-datum coupon and 20-cycle physical fit/marking test on one current book.

acceptance_criteria: All source-defined datum features on the coupon measure within 0.30 mm of their specified values.
One current Original Kraft book inserts and removes without force.
No visible mark appears after 20 insertion/removal cycles.
